product_family: Coda is an enterprise collaborative workspace platform combining document editing, spreadsheet-like tables, and app-building capabilities. Coda AI is an integrated work assistant powered by OpenAI and other LLM providers. Tiered for teams: Product, Marketing, Sales, Engineering, Design, HR.

certifications.name: SOC 2 Type II
certifications.proof_quote: SOC 2 Type II - Trust Services Principles certification available exclusively to enterprise customers upon request.

certifications.name: SOC 3
certifications.proof_quote: SOC 3 - Service Organization Controls report available for download.

certifications.name: ISO 27001
certifications.proof_quote: ISO 27001 - Information Security Management System (ISMS) with downloadable certificate available.

certifications.name: ISO 27017
certifications.proof_quote: ISO 27017 - Addresses Security Controls for the Provision and Use of Cloud Services with certificate provided.

certifications.name: ISO 27018
certifications.proof_quote: ISO 27018 - Focuses on Protection of Personally Identifiable Information (PII) with downloadable documentation.

certifications.name: GDPR
certifications.proof_quote: GDPR - General Data Protection Regulation compliance implemented. Data Processing Addendum (DPA) available for customer data processing.

certifications.name: CCPA
certifications.proof_quote: CCPA - The California Consumer Privacy Act standards are supported.

certifications.name: HIPAA
certifications.proof_quote: Coda is able to assist customers in their HIPAA compliance efforts through the Enterprise plan. Business Associates Agreement (BAA) governs the handling and protection of Protected Health Information.

privacy.ai_training_note: Coda explicitly does NOT allow AI third-party providers or contractors to use customer data for training their models. Coda does NOT use AI inputs and results from enterprise customers for improving Coda AI functionality. Coda AI uses OpenAI and other LLM providers, but maintains strict data handling policies with those providers.
privacy.data_region: Multi-region via AWS: production data replicated across multiple AWS Availability Zones; additionally replicated to a second geographical location for regional outage protection. Specific region selection not publicly documented but standard AWS infrastructure applies.

security.name: Encryption in transit
security.value: TLS 1.2 or higher for all data in transit

security.name: Encryption at rest
security.value: AES-256 symmetric encryption for customer data; AWS Key Management Service (KMS) for encryption key administration and rotation

security.name: Data backups
security.value: Daily backups and cross-regional backups; deleted documents retained in primary storage for 7 days, backup copies retained for 35 days before permanent removal

security.name: Authentication
security.value: SSO via SAML 2.0, Google, Microsoft, Apple, Magic links, and 2-factor authentication (MFA)

security.name: Access control
security.value: Role-based access control (RBAC), Just-in-Time (JIT) access grants, multi-factor authentication for system access, fine-grained controls on docs, folders, Packs, and workspaces

security.name: Audit and logging
security.value: Audit logs capturing privileged operations and security events; logs retained for one (1) year with restricted access; continuous monitoring for suspicious activity

security.name: Penetration testing
security.value: Annual penetration testing across applications, cloud infrastructure, and mobile platforms; public bug bounty program

security.name: Data portability
security.value: Built-in tooling to export and permanently erase customer data; third-party transfers require contracts and EU Standard Contractual Clauses for transfers outside EEA, UK, and Switzerland

security.name: Legal hold and eDiscovery
security.value: Legal hold and eDiscovery capabilities for regulatory compliance; Audit APIs provide 12-month log access

products.name: Coda (Core platform)
products.data_scope: User-generated documents, tables, formulas, integrations with 600+ third-party tools
products.notes: Primary product: combines doc editing, spreadsheets, and app-building in a single platform. Trusted by 80% of Fortune 100.

products.name: Coda AI
products.data_scope: User prompts and document context for AI chat, summarization, table generation, and AI columns
products.notes: Integrated LLM-powered assistant using OpenAI and other models. Does not train on customer data. Enterprise plan includes dedicated AI features.

products.name: Coda for Teams (Product, Marketing, Sales, Engineering, Design, HR)
products.notes: Pre-built solutions for specific team roles; underlying data handling consistent with core platform.

compare.pricing_model: Freemium subscription: Free tier, Team, Business, and Enterprise plans with per-seat or workspace-based pricing. No per-AI-request metering visible; AI credits bundled with plans.
compare.data_residency: Cloud-hosted on AWS with multi-AZ and cross-region replication. No on-premises or self-hosted option documented.

flags: SOC 2 Type II is available exclusively to enterprise customers upon request, not universally available to all users.
HIPAA compliance requires Enterprise plan and Business Associates Agreement (BAA), not available on lower tiers.

Privacy policy URL redirects to Grammarly domain (https://coda.io/trust/privacy → Grammarly privacy), reflecting Grammarly's acquisition of Coda. Verify current privacy policy details directly with Coda or on the Grammarly site.
Data residency not granularly documented; AWS regions not explicitly listed. Enterprises requiring specific region residency (e.g., EU data in EU) should contact sales for details.
No evidence of ISO/IEC 42001 (AI governance) or CSA STAR AI certifications at this time.
